scope: Non-model /usr/bin/true smoke of the new DSV4 matched containment wrapper under the real user-systemd cgroup and global inference lock.

attempts.diagnostic_output: bash -x localized rejection to the fdinfo ownership predicate: the retained flock key was 00:1f:8 but fdinfo recorded the short-lived flock(1) child PID rather than the campaign shell PID

failing_assertion: Both per-arm cgroup launchers require fdinfo field 6 to equal the campaign-shell PID even though flock(1) records its own initiating PID while the shared open file description retains the lock.
production_impact: Every matched campaign arm would fail before containment starts; no engine or GPU process was launched.
bounded_fix: Retain direct-parent PID/start-ticks, descriptor dev:inode, global lock dev:inode, and the exact fdinfo kernel key checks; remove only the invalid fdinfo initiator-PID equality.
